docs.summary: The animated "Nebula" backdrop drawn behind the editor's translucent glass panels (and the project launcher): a deep void, slowly wandering nebula clouds, a baked tileable starfield and the occasional comet.
Whether to draw the coloured nebula gradients.
Whether to draw the tileable starfield and the occasional comets. Only the launcher shows them, since inside a project they show through the windows.
The solid colour drawn behind all other layers.
Initialises the four nebula clouds with randomised positions, sizes and colours.
Advances the nebula animation (clouds and comets) by the given time delta.

members.signature: public void Retint(System.Drawing.Color primary, System.Drawing.Color secondary)

docs.summary: Tint the two dominant nebula clouds with the theme's primary/secondary colours (alpha preserved), so the animated background tracks the active theme.
Pull the current theme's tint + per-layer visibility + void colour onto this instance.

members.signature: public static void DrawEditorBackground(Paper paper, NebulaBackground nebula, string id, float w, float h, float dt, bool showStarsAndComets)

docs.summary: The single editor-backdrop draw path, shared by the editor shell and the launcher: applies the theme settings, advances the animation (respecting speed / frozen), then paints the animated nebula, a static nebula, a gradient, a solid colour or a wallpaper image per the Effects settings. `showStarsAndComets` is true for the launcher and false inside a project.
